findings.evidence: The proof uses only matrix associativity, transpose identities, and `Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/NonsingularInverse.lean:215), which holds over a commutative ring.
findings.fix: Replace `[Field K]` with `[CommRing K]`; state the index assumptions as `[Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]` without requiring an order.
findings.issue: `inv_mul_mul_transpose_inv_mul_eq_one` requires a field although a commutative ring suffices when the determinant is a unit.

findings.evidence: Lines 580–606 use entrywise extensionality and determinant preservation only; `RingHom.map_det` at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Determinant/Basic.lean:320 supports arbitrary finite square matrices.
findings.fix: Generalize to an arbitrary finite index type with decidable equality and specialize to `Fin 2` at the existing call.
findings.issue: `det_glue_eq_one` specializes entrywise Chinese remainder gluing to `Fin 2`, although its proof has no dimension-specific step.

summary: Two extracted matrix lemmas retain unnecessary specializations that restrict their reuse.
